As recently as the 1800s, part of Britain was speaking a language descended from that of the Vikings. On the islands of Orkney and Shetland, Norn was spoken for almost a thousand years – so why did it disappear?

In this video, let's explore Orkney and the remaining fragments of its lost Scandinavian language.
